title: OpenTandem plugin manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a plugin folder. The plugin is the page of an OpenTandem app: a sidebar entry plus a page in the main area.

title.description: Shown in the sidebar and above the page. One string, or one string per language (the console picks the viewer's language, then English, then Chinese).

entry.description: Path of the HTML page to open, relative to the folder root.

name.description: App name. Only read when the folder is imported by a workspace admin (Settings → Apps → Import plugin folder), which creates the app with this name.

scopes.description: Capabilities the page needs, for example ["sessions.list"]. Only read on import: the importing admin confirms them before the app can use them.
